10x PMM Scorecard

Six dimensions, five maturity levels each. Start with Content (required), then add Competitive and Demand Gen if relevant to your role.

Pick the level that best describes where your team operates. The benchmark data shows where the average PMM team sits and where 10x teams are.

Required
Content PMM
Production, brand voice, repurposing, performance, GEO, knowledge infrastructure.
Optional
Competitive Intel
Signal monitoring, battlecards, win/loss, competitor modeling, enablement, market landscape.
Optional
Demand Gen
Campaign production, targeting, personalization, attribution, scoring, channels.
